name: skill
description: Load a skill markdown pack into context by name (on-demand). Supports recursive search, path-like names (e.g., 'coding/debugging'), and multiple return modes.

name.description: Skill name or path (e.g., 'debugging' or 'coding/debugging'). Omit for list mode.

mode.description: Return mode: content (default), path (folder only), meta (metadata), list (all skills)

filter.description: Substring filter on skill name (list mode only)

tags.description: Filter by tags from prompt.json (list mode only)

root.description: Override skillRoots — search only this root
